# Set Up
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(blockCV)
library(dismo)

source(here::here("3-scripts", "1-functions.r"))

trg_crs <- "EPSG:6440"

# Model output directories
cv_directory <- here::here(
  "2-data",
  "models",
  "maxent_cv"
)

final_directory <- here::here(
  "2-data",
  "models",
  "maxent_final"
)

table_directory <- here::here(
  "4-tables-and-figures",
  "tables"
)
```

# Load Data

```{r}

p <- readRDS(here::here('2-data', 'processed', 'oys_proc.rds'))

r_depth <- rast(here::here("2-data", "rasters", "rast_depth.tif"))
r_do <- rast(here::here("2-data", "rasters", "rast_do.tif"))
r_sal <-rast(here::here("2-data", "rasters", "rast_sal.tif"))
r_sed <-rast(here::here("2-data", "rasters", "rast_sed.tif"))
r_turb <-rast(here::here("2-data", "rasters", "rast_turb.tif"))
r_wTemp <-rast(here::here("2-data", "rasters", "rast_wTemp.tif"))

r_stack <- c(r_depth, r_do, r_sal, r_sed, r_turb, r_wTemp)

names(r_stack) <- c(
  "Depth",
  "Dissolved Oxygen",
  "Salinity",
  "Sediment",
  "Turbidity",
  "Water Temperature"
)

r_stack <- terra::project(r_stack, crs = trg_crs)

plot(r_stack)

```

## create mask for point generation
```{r}
predictors <- terra::rast(r_stack)

valid_layer_count  <- terra::app(
  is.finite(predictors),
  fun = "sum"
)

complete_mask <- terra::ifel(
  valid_layer_count == terra::nlyr(predictors),
  1,
  NA
)

plot(complete_mask)

```



# Prepare Point Data

## Species Occurance 

```{r}
#| label: load-and-prepare-oyster-data

p_model <- sf::st_transform(p, trg_crs)

p_values <- terra::extract(
  predictors,
  terra::vect(p_model),
  ID = FALSE
)

valid_presence <- apply(
  is.finite(as.matrix(p_values)),
  1,
  all
)

# Examine the one excluded presence
p_model[!valid_presence, ]

p <- p_model %>%
  mutate(
    pb = 1,
    x = st_coordinates(p)[, "X"],
    y = st_coordinates(p)[, "Y"],
  ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      pb,
      x,
      y,
      geometry
    ) %>%
      st_transform(crs = trg_crs)

sa <- get_study_area()
sa <- st_transform(sa, crs = trg_crs)

plot(st_geometry(sa))

points(
  st_geometry(p),
  pch = 1
)
```

## Species Background Points

```{r}

mask <- raster::raster(complete_mask)
raster::crs(mask) <- trg_crs

p_xy <- st_coordinates(p)[, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE]

set.seed(42)

b <- randomPoints(
  mask = mask,
  n = 1000,
  p = p_xy, 
  excludep = TRUE
)

b <- b %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("x", "y"),
    crs = trg_crs
  )
```

#### Map P-Bg Points
```{r}
#| Draw-map
tmap::tmap_mode("plot")

tmap::tm_shape(mask) +
  tmap::tm_raster(
    col.scale = tmap::tm_scale(values = "grey90"),
    col.legend = tmap::tm_legend_hide()
  )  +
  tmap::tm_shape(b) +
  tmap::tm_symbols(
    fill = NA,
    #alpha = 0.25,
    col = "black",
    shape = 16,
    size = 0.50
  ) +
  tmap::tm_shape(sa) +
  tmap::tm_borders(col = "black", lwd = 1.5) +
  tmap::tm_shape(p) +
  tmap::tm_symbols(
    fill = "red",
    col = "red",
    shape = 16,
    size = 0.50
  )+
  tmap::tm_layout(
    frame = FALSE,
    legend.show = FALSE
  )

```

## Create final data inputs 

```{r}
#| label: final-prep-for-model

# Convert terra predictors to raster::RasterStack
r_stack <- raster::stack(r_stack)
raster::crs(r_stack) <- trg_crs

p_coordinates <- sf::st_coordinates(p)

# Create single presence - background dataset
p_cv <- data.frame(
  x = p_coordinates[,"X"],
  y = p_coordinates[, "Y"],
  pb = 1
) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(
    coords = c("x", "y"),
    crs = trg_crs
  )

b_coordinates <- sf::st_coordinates(b)

b_cv <- data.frame(
  x = b_coordinates[, "X"],
  y = b_coordinates[, "Y"],
  pb = 0
) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(
    coords = c("x", "y"),
    crs = trg_crs
  )

pb_cv <- rbind(
  p_cv,
  b_cv
)
```

```{r}
# Convert back to terra for blockCV
r_cv <- terra::rast(r_stack)

# Create common complete-predictor footprint
valid_cell_count <- terra::app(
  is.finite(r_cv),
  fun = "sum"
)

complete_mask <- terra::ifel(
  valid_cell_count == terra::nlyr(r_cv),
  1,
  NA
)

# Apply the common footprint to every predictor
r_cv <- terra::mask(
  r_cv,
  complete_mask
)

# Extract predictor values at all presence-background points
pb_values <- terra::extract(
  r_cv,
  terra::vect(pb_cv),
  ID = FALSE
)

valid_pb <- apply(
  is.finite(as.matrix(pb_values)),
  1,
  all
)

# Keep only points with complete predictor data
pb_cv_model <- pb_cv[valid_pb, ]

table(pb_cv_model$pb)

```

# Spatial Cross Validation using blockCV package


```{r}
# Get coordinates and corresponding raster cells
pb_coordinates <- sf::st_coordinates(
  pb_cv_model
)[, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE]

cell_id <- raster::cellFromXY(
  r_stack[[1]],
  pb_coordinates
)

presence_rows <- which(pb_cv_model$pb == 1)
background_rows <- which(pb_cv_model$pb == 0)

# Retain one presence per 100 m predictor cell
presence_rows <- presence_rows[
  !duplicated(cell_id[presence_rows])
]

presence_cells <- cell_id[presence_rows]

# Remove background points from presence cells
background_rows <- background_rows[
  !cell_id[background_rows] %in% presence_cells
]

# Retain one background point per cell
background_rows <- background_rows[
  !duplicated(cell_id[background_rows])
]

model_rows <- c(
  presence_rows,
  background_rows
)

maxent_data <- pb_cv_model[
  model_rows,
]

maxent_coordinates <- sf::st_coordinates(
  maxent_data
)[, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE]

# Confirm every point has complete predictor data
predictor_values <- raster::extract(
  r_stack,
  maxent_coordinates
)

stopifnot(
  all(complete.cases(predictor_values)),
  all(is.finite(as.matrix(predictor_values)))
)

table(maxent_data$pb)
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)

fold_id <- dismo::kfold(
  x = data.frame(pb = maxent_data$pb),
  k = 5,
  by = maxent_data$pb
)

maxent_data$fold <- fold_id

table(
  fold = fold_id,
  pb = maxent_data$pb
)
```


```{r}
cv_models <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = 5
)

cv_evaluations <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = 5
)

fold_metrics <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = 5
)

for (i in 1:5) {

  train_rows <- fold_id != i
  test_rows <- fold_id == i

  presence_train <- maxent_coordinates[
    train_rows & maxent_data$pb == 1,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  background_train <- maxent_coordinates[
    train_rows & maxent_data$pb == 0,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  presence_test <- maxent_coordinates[
    test_rows & maxent_data$pb == 1,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  background_test <- maxent_coordinates[
    test_rows & maxent_data$pb == 0,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  fold_directory <- file.path(
    cv_directory,
    paste0("fold_", i)
  )

  dir.create(
    fold_directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  cv_models[[i]] <- dismo::maxent(
    x = r_stack,
    p = presence_train,
    a = background_train,
    factors = "Sediment",
    removeDuplicates = TRUE,
    path = fold_directory
  )

  training_evaluation <- dismo::evaluate(
    p = presence_train,
    a = background_train,
    model = cv_models[[i]],
    x = r_stack,
    args = "outputformat=logistic"
  )

  cv_evaluations[[i]] <- dismo::evaluate(
    p = presence_test,
    a = background_test,
    model = cv_models[[i]],
    x = r_stack,
    args = "outputformat=logistic"
  )

  # Ten-percent training-presence threshold
  threshold_10pct <- as.numeric(
    stats::quantile(
      training_evaluation@presence,
      probs = 0.10,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

  test_omission <- mean(
    cv_evaluations[[i]]@presence < threshold_10pct,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  fold_metrics[[i]] <- data.frame(
    fold = i,
    training_presences = nrow(presence_train),
    testing_presences = nrow(presence_test),
    training_background = nrow(background_train),
    testing_background = nrow(background_test),
    test_auc = cv_evaluations[[i]]@auc,
    threshold_10pct = threshold_10pct,
    test_omission_10pct = test_omission
  )
}

fold_metrics <- do.call(
  rbind,
  fold_metrics
)

fold_metrics

```

### Summarize and save the CV results

```{r}
metric_summary <- data.frame(
  folds = nrow(fold_metrics),
  mean_test_auc = mean(
    fold_metrics$test_auc,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  sd_test_auc = stats::sd(
    fold_metrics$test_auc,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  mean_test_omission_10pct = mean(
    fold_metrics$test_omission_10pct,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  sd_test_omission_10pct = stats::sd(
    fold_metrics$test_omission_10pct,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)

metric_summary

readr::write_csv(
  fold_metrics,
  file.path(
    table_directory,
    "maxent_cross_validation_metrics.csv"
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  metric_summary,
  file.path(
    table_directory,
    "maxent_cross_validation_summary.csv"
  )
)

```

### Fit Final Model

```{r}
all_presences <- maxent_coordinates[
  maxent_data$pb == 1,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

all_background <- maxent_coordinates[
  maxent_data$pb == 0,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

final_model <- dismo::maxent(
  x = r_stack,
  p = all_presences,
  a = all_background,
  factors = "Sediment",
  removeDuplicates = TRUE,
  path = final_directory
)

saveRDS(
  final_model,
  here::here(
    "2-data",
    "models",
    "maxent_final_model.rds"
  )
)

```



```{r}

maxent_suitability <- dismo::predict(
  object = final_model,
  x = r_stack,
  args = "outputformat=logistic",
  filename = here::here(
    "2-data",
    "rasters",
    "maxent_suitability.tif"
  ),
  format = "GTiff",
  overwrite = TRUE,
  progress = "text"
)

tmap_mode("plot")

suitability_map <-
  tm_shape(maxent_suitability) +
  tm_raster(
    col.scale = tm_scale_continuous(
      values = "viridis",
      limits = c(0, 1)
    ),
    col.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "Suitability"
    )
  ) +
  tm_shape(p) +
  tm_dots(
    fill = "black",
    size = 0.05
  ) +
  tm_layout(
    frame = FALSE
  ) +
  tm_title(
    "Eastern Oyster Habitat Suitability"
  )

suitability_map
```
